_doc: Numbers in main.tex that are configuration or protocol settings, not results. Each lists where it is set.
4: default organizations: test.yml up.sh 4; also 4 vCPU runner
5: organizations max; test seeds 1-5; delta=5 s (bench bootstrap)
16: runner RAM 16 GB (GitHub docs, smoke runner.txt)
20: min items per outage; pre ops per type: bench e1 -pre 20; outage D=20 min
60: max items per outage; warm-up 60 s (bench e3 -warmup)
10: post ops per type: bench e1 -post 10; eps=10 s; outage D=10 min
1: item rate 1 item/s; sensor batch about 1 KB; outage D=1
50: alert log max 50 KB; load 50 items/s; b candidate 50
100: b=100 selected (results/tables/tuning.json); load 100 items/s in tuning objective
9,600: derived setting: 8 gateways x 20 min x 60 items/min (bench e2 -outages, -gws)
9600: derived setting: 8 gateways x 20 min x 60 items/min (bench e2 -outages, -gws)
